description: This Java class is a command handler for updating password preferences in the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, is annotated as a Spring service, and uses a platform service to perform the update operation.

classes.name: UpdatePasswordPreferencesCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the command to update password preferences, delegating the operation to the PasswordPreferencesWritePlatformService.

methods.name: UpdatePasswordPreferencesCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the PasswordPreferencesWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command by calling the updatePreferences method on the platform service.
